description: Validate a work item for Ready, label it status:ready, and post the Ready snapshot; --check is read-only.

changes.description: With --request: a JSON array with one entry per change since the last baseline (ref, what, why, need). A version after v1 needs what changed, why it matters, and the need behind it for each change.

early-build.description: A child story of the Feature, labelled early-build, that a person approves to build before Approve to build, within [baselines] early_build_budget × [autonomy.budget] cost_usd; GitHub's device flow every time, refused for an agent lane. Its PR never merges into dev.

fixes.description: With --request: comma-separated IDs (<part>-v<k>/<seat>/<n>) of this part's review findings that the new version fixes; the draft's hash covers them.

guard.description: Ready guard (the aayudha-ready-guard workflow): strip status:ready when the issue no longer validates or drifted from its snapshot.

issue.description: Work item to make Ready. On a Feature this is Approve to build: a person approves its baselines, stories, and budget through GitHub's device flow, and it is refused for an agent lane.

part.description: Feature part to baseline: a person approves its waiting draft, through GitHub's device flow every time; refused for an agent lane.

request.description: With --part: draft the part's next baseline on the ledger (specs/<f>/baselines/<part>-v<k>.draft.json) and ask a person to approve it; never approves.

title: ready
